messages:
izzy (AE): Customer POC failed — single POST with repo + attachments returned 413. Demo tomorrow, they want a quick fix.

Nate (Solutions): Can you paste the curl + size? 413 usually client_max_body_size on gateway.

izzy (AE): They sent ~3.8MB JSON (raw text + base64 images), curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @payload.json
```
Response: 413 Request Entity Too Large.

olga (Eng): Confirmed — hosted gateway default ~2MB. Options: 1) client-side chunking (sliding windows), 2) use presigned upload + send URL so server fetches, 3) multipart stream / chunked transfer encoding, 4) temporary gateway bump for a short POC (internal only).

izzy (AE): Customer wants minimal code change. Prefer not to add S3 infra right now.

Nate (Solutions): For minimal change: streaming multipart or chunking. If they can implement basic client chunking quickly here's pseudo: 
```
chunks = slide(doc, size=3000tokens, overlap=150)
outs = [api.generate(chunk) for chunk in chunks]
result = merge(outs)
```
Works for both embeddings and chat.

Sam (Support): Gzip can help reduce wire size but gateway still checks decompressed size; won't help for huge token counts. Also some enterprise proxies reject gzip.

olga (Eng): Another low-lift approach: client uploads large payload to their blob store and POSTs a presigned URL to us. Our ingestion worker will fetch and run inference. We can share a sample server-side handler.

izzy (AE): If we give them chunking snippet + a short fallback doc, will that be enough for tomorrow?

Nate (Solutions): Yes. Also warn about model context limits (e.g., redwood-32k will truncate >32k tokens). Recommend a server-side preflight: count tokens and return clear error saying "document exceeds max model context; please chunk or request Dedicated".

Sam (Support): I'll open a support ticket to offer a temporary gateway increase for demo hours if they want a single-call demo. Label: POC urgent.

infra-bot: Ticket #S-10377 created by Sam at 2026-03-28T11:12:10Z

olga (Eng): Quick note: multipart chunked transfer to our upload endpoint avoids full buffering client-side, but many SDKs need manual wiring. If they want this, we can pair briefly.

izzy (AE): I'll send chunking + presigned URL examples and ask if they'd like the temp bump. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
